description: A real browser for AI agents: navigate, read, click, type - with challenge handling under a budget

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_BROWSER_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to watch the browser work.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_BROWSER_ALLOWLIST
